from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import cupy as cp
from gpu_coupled_world import GpuCoupledWorld
for material in ('glass','oak','iron','ice'):
 w=GpuCoupledWorld({'material':material});e=w.eval
 v=e.bodies[:,14:20].reshape(-1);base=e.evaluate(v,1/960)
 d=len(e.dynamic);p=cp.broadcast_to(v,(2*d,len(v))).copy();ids=cp.arange(d)
 p[ids,e.dynamic]+=1e-12/e.active_weights;p[d+ids,e.dynamic]-=1e-12/e.active_weights
 o=e.evaluate(p,1/960,_jacobian_base=base);cp.cuda.get_current_stream().synchronize()
 assert not bool(cp.any(o['faults']))
print('Full/within-Jacobian parallel CUDA memory checks passed')

for material in ('glass','oak','iron','ice'):
 for experiment in ('sheet','freefall'):
  w=GpuCoupledWorld(dict(material=material,ball_material=material,experiment=experiment,height_m=.001));e=w.eval
  if experiment=='freefall':e.bodies[-1,15]=-.3
  p=e.contact_schedule(1/240,.25);assert 0<p['step_s']<=1/240
cp.cuda.get_current_stream().synchronize()
print('Shared contact policy CUDA memory checks passed')

import json,numpy as np
from gpu_coupled_world import CoupledEvaluator,TrialFailure
record=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/gpu-newton-diagnostics/glass-refusal.json').read_text())['refusal']['last_solver_failure']
e=CoupledEvaluator(np.asarray(record['initial_bodies']),np.asarray(record['initial_edges']),newton_strategy='single-reference',line_search='batch-tail')
try:e.solve(record['dt_s']);raise AssertionError('Recorded refusal was admitted')
except TrialFailure as failure:assert str(failure)=='Coupled Newton line search did not reduce the equation residual'
cp.cuda.get_current_stream().synchronize()
print('Actual full-step/tail-probe Newton refusal CUDA memory checks passed')
